newsitem.title: USA: B-2 bomber completes precision bomb tests in Nevada.
newsitem.headline: B-2 bomber completes precision bomb tests in Nevada.

text.p: B-2 stealth bombers completed testing last week of precision guided bombs that can be carried any place in the world for strikes in the first hours of a war, the Air Force said on Thursday.
It said three of the radar-evading bombers blasted 16 targets off the Nevada desert Oct. 8 with 16 bombs dropped from about six miles (10 km) away.
"The B-2 can be to any point on the globe in less than 24 hours with air refueling ... (with) near to precision accuracy and ... in any weather," Brig. Gen. Thomas Goslin told a news briefing.
He said the live bombing demonstration last week completed testing and the bombs will go into all B-2 bombers, 16 each, next spring ready for use.
